problem_summary: 13 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Gayathri Nagar between January 2019 and November 2021, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 23% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 55 pothole complaints.
19 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹12.4 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).

agency_attribution_note: 13 of 13 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.44). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, complaint_volume=0.43, unresolved_rate=0.23.

recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Gayathri Nagar for the period 2019–2021.
Request inspection records for the 19 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
